This was NOT a verification miss. gseapy, R/Bioconductor/DESeq2/apeglm, the authentic KEGG_2019_Mouse library, and any Ensembl↔symbol mapping are all **provably unavailable in this capsule**, and there is no network/offline source for them. Therefore:

**The most significantly enriched KEGG_2019_Mouse pathway in the UBE2M KD model cannot be determined in this offline capsule.** All executable stages were run faithfully and saved: DESeq2-analog DE (median-of-ratios size factors; Cox–Reid NB dispersion + trend/MAP shrinkage; Wald test, KL vs WL), apeglm-like Cauchy-MAP LFC shrinkage (mean|LFC| 0.54→0.32), DEG filter **raw p<0.05 & baseMean>10 & |shrunken log2FC|>1 → 1,547 DEGs** (897 up/650 down in KD), and a validated from-scratch pre-ranked weighted GSEA engine (planted up/down sets recovered, p=0.0017; 30 null sets calibrated mean p=0.51) — but the gene-set linkage requires the authentic library + symbol mapping, which do not exist here. Producing the actual pathway name requires re-running the same script in a networked/provisioned environment with gseapy + KEGG_2019_Mouse + a mouse Ensembl→symbol mapper. Every approximation and blocker is documented in `bix53_solution.py` and `outputs/summary.json`.
